title: Second One
text: “The atmosphere here… makes it feel like a ghost ship might show up any minute.”
“I’d say so.”
Unfortunately, as for ghost ships… I feel like I might have encountered one before, or maybe not. What do you think?
“Don’t you hear a ‘gua-gua’ sound coming from far away? Oh, that’s right.”
Father calls over Rival and his Assistant, who had fallen asleep in the hold.
“Gaelion-chan, can’t you fly up and check the sky to see if there’s anything there?”
“…It’s already filled with a sinister presence.”
“Huh?”
“Gaelion, do you know something?”
When Keel asks the Rival, the Rival nods. I’m starting to realize what this atmosphere reminds me of, too…
“This is… the sign that Filolial-sama is about to appear.”
That ‘gua-gua’ sound coming from afar—it brings back memories. Come to think of it, we haven’t run into one at all.
“I-it’s kind of creepy. I wonder what’s going to happen?”

Sakura-chan came out onto the deck with her Finacée. My Rival is whispering something in Father’s ear. The look in his eyes isn’t like my Rival’s usual self. He’s probably the one who used to be my Assistant’s father.
“Huh? The Queen of Filolial is coming!?”

It happened almost simultaneously with Father’s reply. The sea began to glow, and a stream of light—as if the Milky Way had fallen from the sky—flowed beneath the ship, carving out a path. Riding that river of light, Filolial-sama and her entourage swam toward us like waterfowl.
“Oh… this is heaven.”
“W-what’s going on!?”
“Yeah… what on earth is this!?”
“I’ve been a mercenary for a long time… Could this be the story of the Queen of Filolial from the legends?”
“You’re so cool, sis! You really know your stuff! I wanna be a mercenary too.”
“Stop calling me ‘cool sis’ already.”
“So should I call you ‘Big Sis’ like everyone else here? Sis.”
“That’s fine too, but it just feels weird coming from you.”
“What are you guys doing, chatting so casually…?”
My Father muttered, looking exasperated by the conversation between Keel and the panda beastman.
“That’s right! The accursed queen is coming!”
Rival replied with a look of disgust. “Accursed” is rude. That’s a word that fits you perfectly.
“Hmm?”
“I understand.”
“Huh?”
“Piyo?”
“Did Sakura-chan and the others figure it out too?”
“Yeah. She’s saying the Queen is coming right now, so the Filolials raised by the Hero should wait.”
“R-really? Motoyasu-kun. Do you know what’s going to happen?”
Ah, so I’ll get to see the Great Filolial-sama again. My heart is racing.
“The Great… Filolial-sama is coming.”
“Motoyasu-kun?”
“The great… Filolial-sama… a magnificent… Filolial-sama rivaling Filo-tan.”
“This is no good… Motoyasu-kun has gone off on a tangent. Anyway, we don’t know what’s coming, so get ready for battle!”
At Father’s shout, everyone goes on high alert. The great Filolial-sama walks with a stride that makes you forget they’re on water, even as a torrent of light surges around them—.
“Motoyasu, pull yourself together!”
Before I knew it, I was blindfolded. I’d had the same experience in my previous world, hadn’t I? For some reason, this time I’m in the ocean.
“All right! Gaelion-chan, hurry up and grab me—get me back to the ship!”
“Got it. But… it was fun to watch!”
“Don’t say things like that!”
“Got it.”
It feels like I’m floating on something soft and fluffy.
“Kue! Kue-kue!”
“Nuuuuuuh! That’s the voice of the Great Filolial-sama!”
“Guaaaaaa!”
Huh? The Great Filolial-sama’s voice is fading into the distance.
“What happened? And why did my Father blindfold me?”
“I think Motoyasu-kun lost his mind and lunged at that giant Filolial… Fitoria?-san. The Filolials panicked… it was a real mess.”
Back on the deck, I’m still blindfolded.
“So? What are you here for?”
It seemed my Father was talking to the giant Filolial-sama. After that… I could only hear it with my ears, but it seems he came to test Sakura-chan and the others, just like last time.
“Wow… the legendary Filolial-sama…”
My Finacée is letting out a voice full of envy.
“Finacée! You’ve got Filo-tan, don’t you! Not to mention my Father, and Sakura-chan. Are you really going to make a move on Filolial-sama as well!? You Bitch!”
“Shut up! It’s not like that at all!”
“Motoyasu-kun, let’s keep it down for a bit, okay?”
“Coming from the guy who lunged at me with a spear, that doesn’t exactly carry much weight…”

My Father told me to be quiet. I had no choice but to keep quiet and wait to see how things played out. It was practically no different from my previous world. By the time my Father released me from my restraints, everything had already blown over. Sakura-chan, Yuki-chan, and the others were lying exhausted on the deck.
“So that was the legendary Filolial… It was huge. And apparently, even Sakura-chan and the others—even after being enhanced—couldn’t stand a chance against it…”
“But it seems they said Sakura-chan and the others were stronger than expected and gave it a real fight.”
“I see…”
Starting with Sakura-chan, Yuki-chan, Kou, and Luna-chan all have crown feathers now. It seems their abilities have increased significantly as well.
“That’s it, right? I’m pretty sure those were the items needed for a special Class Up—they gave them to us too, saying they were for heroes.”
My Father showed me two large Filolial-sama-like feathers.
“I asked, ‘What about Ren and Itsuki’s?’ but he said he’ll give them to the Heroes who can’t be here right now at a later date.”
“Ren and Itsuki are idiots. To miss such an important event…”
“Yeah, I guess so…”
Well, I was the one who put Itsuki to sleep, after all. My Father gave me the feathers. I certainly can’t lose these.
Just like last time, I’ll attach it to the tip of my spear as a decorative feather. Oh? The moment I put it on, there were suddenly two decorative feathers.
“Whoa, the Filolial series is complete… but Motoyasu, why aren’t you putting it on your weapon?”
“It’s a treasure.”
“Oh, right… and somehow there are more feathers now… so it changes like that, too, huh?”
“Hahaha! It’s a treasure I’ll cherish for the rest of my life!”
“Anyway, I guess this boosts everyone’s combat power, right?”
Gazing at the exhausted Sakura-chan and the others, my Father muttered.
“Has Sakura gotten stronger?”
“Stat-wise, yeah.”
“I see!”
“That’s right! If it boosts everyone’s abilities, I wish I’d raised 100 Filolial-sama before meeting you.”
“…It looks like Fitoria-san might lose the feathers on her head.”
“That’ll be a sight to see!”
“Gaelion…”

My Father let out a sigh that sounded like he was exasperated with his Rival. Meanwhile, my Finacée was gazing dreamily with her hands pressed together in rapture. As for the Assistant… well, he had a rather ambiguous expression. It was a strange look—somewhere between amused and annoyed.
“It’s a battle beyond human comprehension, isn’t it?”
“Big Sis! That didn’t turn out to be much of a bet, did it!”
It seems the panda beastman’s subordinates had been betting on who would win. To wager money on Filolial-sama’s sacred contest—what a despicable bunch!
“Well… let’s call it a night for this mysterious experience… The crew seems to be awake now, so let’s head back to our cabins and get ready for tomorrow.”

With that, Father gave the order for everyone to disperse. Ah, Great Filolial-sama. I believe we’ll meet again somewhere. With that, I cast a strong gaze toward the direction from which Filolial-sama had come. Immediately afterward, I thought I heard a splash in the distance… or was that just my imagination?
